Title: Rocketman
Description: Step right up! Load a fearless stunt kid into the circus cannon and fire them across the sky. Bounce on trampolines, pop balloons, fly through hoops and smash crate walls as you go. Grab coins to upgrade your gunpowder, aero suit, helmet, scope and rocket. Then fly farther through five areas: the Big Top, the Fairground, the City, the Sky and Space. Complete missions, unlock new looks and beat your record on every launch!
Instructions:
- Aim: Drag to aim the cannon. On a keyboard, use the Arrow keys or W/S.
- Launch: Press and hold to fill the power meter, then release to fire. Let go at the right moment for a PERFECT shot!
- Rocket boost: While flying, hold the mouse button, your finger on the screen or Space to fire your rocket. Watch your fuel.
- Upgrade: Spend your coins between launches to fly even farther.

Controls: Mouse / Touch, or Space / Enter + Arrow keys (W/S)

Title: Last Ring
Description: The ring is closing and the monsters keep coming. Survive five minutes inside a shrinking arena where you only move and your weapons fire on their own. Dodge through the horde, grab the gems monsters drop, and pick a new skill every time you level up. Pair a weapon with its matching passive to evolve it, defeat two bosses, and unlock harder rings.
Instructions: Desktop: move with WASD or the arrow keys, or hold the mouse button and drag. Press P or Esc to pause. Mobile: drag anywhere on the screen to move. Attacks are automatic. Stay inside the ring, collect gems to level up, and survive for five minutes.

Title: Auto Factory Tycoon
Description: Auto Factory Tycoon is a 3D factory management game where you build and automate an automotive production empire. Carry parts, operate production lines, hire workers and forklift drivers, expand into robotic welding and rework, ship finished components, and unlock a second company with a complete paint and curing process.
Instructions: Move with WASD or the arrow keys on desktop, or use push-and-drag controls on mobile. Walk to colored work zones to pick up and place parts. Earn money from production and shipments, then buy machines, operators, forklifts and new production lines. Every upgrade can also be unlocked by watching a rewarded ad.

Title: Grass Rush Adventure
Description:
Cut grass, discover rare treasures, and grow stronger with every swing! Grass Rush Adventure is a colorful incremental game where you explore six worlds and uncover more than 300 collectible treasures.

Sell your finds to buy stronger tools, expand your backpack, and upgrade your cutting range, speed, luck, and pickup reach. Equip magical auras and rebirth for permanent Strength and Gold bonuses that help you push further.
Instructions:
WASD or Arrow Keys - Move.
Space or hold Left Mouse Button - Swing your tool. Cutting also starts automatically near grass.
B - Open or close your backpack; leave Daily Garden when inside.
S - Sell all items while your backpack is open.
Esc - Open Settings or close the current menu.
Left Mouse Button - Select items and use menus.

Title: Mini Golf 3D - Island Course
Description: Mini Golf 3D - Island Course is a 51-hole putting course on a small island. Bank shots off wooden rails, roll up ramps, time spinning rotors and drop through wormholes. Race the ghost of your best run, beat a live rival, and come back daily for a fresh one-hole challenge. Five game modes, 153 stars to earn, 13 balls and 6 weather themes. No sign-up needed.
Instructions: Mouse: press the ball, pull back and let go to putt. The arrow shows aim and power, so pull further for a harder hit. Drag anywhere else to look around and press Esc to pause. Touch: pull back from the ball and lift your finger to putt, then drag anywhere else to move the camera. Sink the ball in as few strokes as you can.

Title: Royal Grid
Description: Royal Grid is a calm logic puzzle where every board has exactly one solution and can be solved by pure logic, no guessing. Place one crown in every row, every column and every color region, without letting any two crowns touch, not even diagonally. Start with tiny 5x5 boards and climb level by level up to 9x9 master puzzles. Stuck? The hint button doesn't just show the answer, it explains why a cell must be a crown. Works on desktop and mobile, available in English and Korean.
Instructions: Tap or click a cell to place a crown, tap it again to remove it. Cells ruled out by your crowns are dotted automatically. Fill every row, column and color region with exactly one crown, and keep crowns from touching (including diagonally). Use the hint button if you get stuck.

Title: Anything Goes: Stickman Brawl
Description: Anything Goes: Stickman Brawl is a 3D fighting game with five stickmen and five martial arts: Rocco (street fighting), Mei (kung fu), Javier (boxing), Dandara (capoeira) and Junke (wrestling). Chain combos, land special moves and grab bats, chairs or bottles to fight in 15 stages full of hazards like lava, trains and traffic. Play Story, Arena, Tower, Challenges, 1 Player with AUTO difficulty or 2 Players on one keyboard.
Instructions:
Player 1 (keyboard)
A / D: move, W or Space: jump, S: crouch
J: light punch, U: heavy punch
K: light kick, I: heavy kick
L: grab, pick up or throw items
Left Shift: block (right as a hit lands: Combo Break)
H: dodge (hold H + W/A/S/D: move freely, double-tap: run)
J + K: Energy Super (full bar), U + I: Guard Break
P: pause

Player 2 (keyboard)
Arrow keys: move, Numpad 8: jump
Numpad 1 / 4: light / heavy punch
Numpad 2 / 5

Title: Stickfront Conquest
Description: Lead a stickman army to victory in a strategic battle for territory. Gather gold and stone, recruit and upgrade diverse units, unlock new abilities, and destroy the enemy stronghold across increasingly challenging levels.
Instructions: Use the mouse or touch controls to select units, manage resources, and command your army. Recruit miners to gather gold and stone, then deploy combat units to attack the enemy base. Use the on-screen settings to adjust sound and language.

Title: Beauties Goblincore Aesthetic Fashion
Description: Step into the enchanting world of Goblincore, where beauty is imperfect, earthy, and full of personality. In Beauties Goblincore Aesthetic Fashion, you’ll style trendy characters using outfits inspired by moss, mushrooms, natural textures, cozy sweaters, messy accessories, and forest magic.
Instructions: Left Mouse button click or Tap to play

Title: Clean the Squishes! ASMR Sorting Obby
Description:
CLEAN UP THE SQUISHY STORE!
The best squishes in one game! Dumplings, Butter, NeeDoh and other popular ASMR toys are scattered all over a huge D store. Collect them all and place them on the correct shelves!
The more toys you organize, the more rewards you'll earn! Make money, buy upgrades, boost your aura, unlock new abilities, and become the fastest player to clean the entire store!
In the game you'll find:
Hundreds of squishies and popular toys
Relaxing ASMR sorting and store cleaning
Instructions:
Desktop
WASD — Move
Left Mouse Button — Hide cursor (activate camera)
Mouse — Look around
F — Show cursor
Space — Jump
Left Mouse Button — Pick up, squeeze or place a squish
Q — Throw a squish
E — Activate ability
– — Inventory navigation
G — Switch mode
Y — Settings
C — Magic
B — Inventory
Z — Upgrades
V — Shop
R — Rewards
Mobile Controls
Use the joystick to move.
Swipe on the right side of the screen to control the camera.
To pick up a squish, aim the camera at it and tap the item.

Title: Tower Truck: Zombie Siege
Description: The dead own the highway, and your truck is the only thing still moving. Bolt guns onto a tower truck, stack new floors, and upgrade the frame from wood to void-core alloy while endless zombie waves roll in. Choose what to build and where to place it, then fire commander skills at the right moment to turn a losing wave around. Fight across 18 cities and 90 levels. No account and no download needed: your progress is saved in your browser.
Instructions: Mouse or touch only. Tap a truck slot to buy, upgrade or unlock it. Drag weapons between slots to rearrange them. Tap the skill buttons to use commander and weapon skills (they cost energy). Pick a level with the arrows and press Deploy. AUTO plays the battle for you.

Title: Spooky Halloween Makeover
Description: Get ready for a spine-chilling adventure with Spooky Halloween Makeover, the ultimate game that combines creativity, style, and a touch of the supernatural. Dive into a world filled with eerie glamour, where you transform a beauty into a Halloween icon and design a haunted yet stylish Halloween-themed room. With 15 distinct Halloween makeover styles and endless room customization options, this game offers thrills and creativity at every turn.
Instructions: Left Mouse button click or tap to play

Title: Alien Rocket : Cosmic Escape
Description:
Alien Rocket: Cosmic Escape is a fast-paced space survival game where you pilot a futuristic alien rocket from Earth’s atmosphere into deep space.

Dodge dangerous asteroids and enemy UFOs, survive challenging boss battles, complete missions, collect Stardust, unlock achievements, and discover unique futuristic rocket skins.

As you climb higher, the environment changes from the atmosphere to the vastness of space, while the challenges become increasingly intense.
Instructions:
Single Player – PC

W / A / S / D — Move the rocket
Arrow Keys — Move the rocket
P / ESC — Pause

2 Player Split-Screen – PC

Player 1: W / A / S / D
Player 2: Arrow Keys
Both players must survive as long as possible.

Title: Climb Everest
Description: Climb from Everest Base Camp to the summit at 8,849 metres. Pick your way through the Khumbu Icefall, cross ladders over crevasses, clip into fixed ropes and climb the Lhotse Face. Rest and restock at camps, manage your stamina, warmth, water and oxygen, and watch for changing weather on the way to the Southeast Ridge. Reach the summit, plant your flag and take in the view. Checkpoints save your progress for the next expedition session.
Instructions:
Desktop: WASD or arrow keys to move; drag the mouse to look; Space to jump; Shift to run; E to interact; C to brace; O to toggle oxygen; M for the map; Esc to pause; 1–5 to use items. Keys can be changed in Settings.

Mobile: move with the left joystick and drag the view to look. Tap JUMP, USE and RUN; hold BRACE. Tap backpack items, oxygen, map and menu buttons.

Follow the red route flags. Rest and restock at camps before climbing higher.

Title: Gnome Deep
Description: Gnomes are digging under an old oak stump for the lost Gnome King's hoard, and every pest can hear them. Dig louder for more gold and a faster dig, but the louder the digging, the more beetles, slugs, crows and worse come for the burrow. Crossbow gnomes, a catapult, an old owl and a cousin with a shovel hold the walls. Every new layer wakes a boss that blocks the tunnel. When the burrow falls, spend your gems in the workshop and dig deeper next time. Eight layers down, the Wyrm is waiting.
Instructions: Tap Louder or Quieter to set how noisy the digging is. Tap the upgrade cards to buy. Tap a pest to see what it is. Plays on phones held either way. Keyboard: up and down arrows for the noise, 1 to 5 for the tabs, Q W E to buy, F for speed, G for a gold rush, P or Space to pause, M for sound on or off, ? for options.

Title: Typeblade: Shadow Dojo
Description: Defend the Shadow Dojo in a fast-paced typing action game! Use your keyboard as a weapon: type the first letter above an enemy to lock on, then complete the word to unleash a deadly sword strike. Build combos, increase your score multiplier, earn lifelines, and survive waves of Shadow Warriors, Night Runners, armored Oni Guards, and powerful Oni Lords. Fight through 20 waves and 2 boss battles in Dojo Trial, or test your skills in Endless mode. Collect coins to unlock blades and skins.
Instructions:
Desktop:
Use your keyboard to type the letters above enemies. Type the first letter to lock onto an enemy, then complete the word to attack. Press Backspace or Tab to cancel the current lock-on.

Mobile:
Use the on-screen keyboard to type. Tap an enemy to lock onto them, then type the displayed word to attack. Tap DEL to cancel the current lock-on.

Defeat enemies, build your combo, collect coins, and survive as many waves as possible.

Title: FlakWing
Description: Flakwing is a vertical air-combat shooter where every upgrade counts. Battle through 18 missions over tropical islands, deserts, frozen mountains and enemy bases. Dodge incoming fire, rescue stranded pilots and defeat powerful bosses. Collect stars to upgrade six aircraft systems and unlock stronger planes. Clear Easy to unlock Medium, then Hard, or challenge yourself in Daily Sortie and Endless Survival. Progress saves automatically in your browser.
Instructions:
Move with WASD or arrow keys, or drag with your mouse or finger. Your cannon fires automatically. Use Space for bombs, Q for shields and E for lasers when available. 

On mobile, tap the bottom weapon buttons. Press P/Escape or tap Pause to pause or resume.

Collect stars, stay inside rescue beacons to save pilots, and upgrade your aircraft between missions. Special weapons have limited charges.

Title: TILT
Description: A small pachinko roguelite. Aim, let go and watch the ball bounce down a board of pegs: every peg adds chips or multiplier, and the bucket it lands in multiplies again. Beat each round's target with five balls, then spend your coins in the shop on new pegs (bombs, splitters, glass, stars, echoes) and charms that change the rules. Survive three boss rounds that bend the board and clear all 12 rounds to beat the house, then keep going in endless mode.
Instructions: Point with the mouse or a finger and release to drop a ball. Arrow keys aim and Space drops. In the shop, tap a price to buy.

Title: Sprinkle Roll
Description: Sprinkle Roll is a fast 3D ball game high above the clouds. Steer your candy ball down a sugary sky track that winds, tilts and gets faster the further you go. Hit rainbow ramps for a Sugar Rush speed boost, weave past candy-cane sweepers, sliding gates and pop-up peppermint blocks, hop across moving platforms and race through candy tunnels. How far can you roll?
Instructions: Arrow keys or A / D to steer, or drag with the mouse. On mobile, slide your finger left or right. P or Esc to pause, Space to play again.

Title: Halloween Dress Up Party
Description: Halloween Dress Up Party is a spooky-cute fashion game in six themed levels: witch, vampire, zombie, ghost, pumpkin and mummy. Style the model from head to toe with skin tones, faces, hairstyles, dresses, capes, shoes, hats, jewelry, bags, pets and backgrounds. Tap Done and three judges score your look for up to 3 stars. Every finished look is saved to your gallery and unlocks the next party. No reading needed: play on phone, tablet or desktop.
Instructions: Tap or click to play. Pick a party on the map, choose a tab (skin, face, hair, dress, shoes, hat, pet, background...) and tap a card to put that item on. Use the dice for a random look or reset to start over. Tap Done to let the judges score your look, then Next to save it to your gallery and unlock the next party.

Title: Color Sort Party
Description: Have fun with this super-addictive game. Get to work: pour liquids between tubes, sort the colors and beat increasingly challenging levels. Use special boosters, think strategically and keep moving forward.
Instructions: Select a tube and pour the liquid into another, matching the colors. Be careful! Don't get stuck! Use boosters like Level Skip, One Step Back or Extra Tube to stay ahead. Play on 4 tropical backgrounds and customize your tubes with up to 18 different styles.

Title: One Shot Duel Snipe Hide
Description: One Shot Duel: Snipe Hide combines thrilling shooting challenges with clever hide-and-seek gameplay. Perfect for fans of action games. Enjoy one of the best free shooting games directly in your browser without downloads.
Instructions:
On PC
AD: Move.
J: Shoot.
Subway Escape Mode: WASD to move. F: Shoot. Shift: Crouch. Space: Jump. G: Bomb. R: Reload. E: Aim. C: Bag. Number1-4: Items
On Mobile
Click the on-screen button to operate.

Title: Adopt a Monster
Description: Merge spooky creatures and build your own monster collection in Adopt a Monster! Combine matching monsters to discover new forms, complete orders, and grow your collection in a cozy Halloween setting.
Instructions: Click or tap matching monsters to merge them into a new creature. Complete orders and collect rewards to expand your monster collection.

Title: Ghost Hunt: Spirit Scanner
Description:
Ghosts hide among people and objects inside each room. Examine your surroundings, aim the scanner at suspicious targets, and search for paranormal traces. A correct reading reveals the hidden spirit.

Find the ghost, choose your weapon, and destroy the threat. Earn rewards for clearing rooms, then upgrade your hand, scanner, and weapon to complete new assignments faster.
Instructions:
1. Goal: investigate each room, scan people and objects, find hidden ghosts, and destroy them. After each level, upgrade your hand for interacting with objects, your scanner for searching, and your weapon for attacking.

2. Controls:
— Desktop: hold the left mouse button and guide the pointer to look around, aim the scanner, and select targets.
— Mobile and tablet: swipe across the screen to move your view, scan the room, and interact with objects.

Title: Blobby Jars
Description: A relaxing color sorting puzzle with cute squishy blobs. Tap a jar to pick up the blobs on top, then tap another jar to pour them in. Blobs can only go on the same color or into an empty jar. Fill every jar with just one color to win!
Instructions: Tap or click a jar to pick up the top blobs, then tap another jar to pour them in. Keyboard: 1-9 select jars, Z undo, R restart, H hint.

Title: Quiz Journey: Trivia Adventure
Description: Quiz Journey: Trivia Adventure turns general knowledge into a colorful journey! Answer thousands of questions on all kinds of topics as you travel across the level map. Earn stars and coins, build your collection piece by piece and hunt for the rarest items. Stuck on a tough one? Remove two wrong answers, ask the audience, skip the question or protect yourself with a shield. Come back every day for free rewards and spin the lucky wheel!
Instructions:
Answer trivia questions, move along the level map and collect rewards. Use hints when you get stuck!
Controls (PC / Mobile):
- Click / Tap an answer to select it.
- Click / Tap the question text to skip the typing animation.
- Click / Tap a hint button to use a hint: 50/50, Ask the Audience, Skip or Shield.

Title: Wheelie Spooky
Description: Ride through haunted roads in Wheelie Spooky! Balance your bike, perform tricks, collect coins, and unlock spooky costumes and bikes.
Instructions:
Keyboard: 
- Gas: → / D / Space 
- Brake: ← / A  
- Stand: ↑ / W stand on the seat
- Trick: ↓ / S 

Touch: 
4 zones under your two thumbs

Title: Ludo Quick: Dice Board Games
Description: Ludo Quick: Dice Board Games brings classic Ludo to your phone with fast, smooth, and exciting gameplay. Roll the dice, move your tokens, and race to get them home before your opponents. Enjoy offline play, smart opponents, simple controls, colorful boards, and a perfect mix of luck and strategy. Play quick matches anytime and become the ultimate Ludo champion!
Instructions: Tap the Roll Dice button to roll the dice. When a valid move is available, tap the token you want to move. Plan your moves carefully, protect your tokens, and capture opponent tokens by landing on their position. Controls are simple and easy to learn, making Ludo Quick fun for players of all ages.

Title: Mine Hunt Classic
Description:
⭐ Mine Hunt Classic is a classic minesweeper experience where every move counts! ? Reveal the tiles, use the numbers to detect nearby mines, and carefully mark dangerous spots with flags. But be careful — one wrong move and BOOM!
Choose from Easy, Normal, and Hard difficulties, with different board sizes and mine counts.
Think ahead. Stay sharp. Hunt the mines!
⚡ Simple to play, challenging to master — Mine Hunt Classic brings the timeless minesweeper puzzle to your screen.
Instructions:
Click / Tap to reveal safe tiles.
Right click / Hold Tap to flag suspicious tiles.
Click / Tap a number to check its linked tiles.
Your Mission:
   • Reveal all safe tiles
   • Avoid hidden mines
   • Flag suspicious locations
   • Complete each board as fast as possible
   • Challenge yourself to improve your best time

Title: Fruit Blast
Description: Dive into the juicy world of Fruit Blast! Match colorful fruits, create explosive combos, and complete exciting levels. Use powerful boosters, sharpen your puzzle skills, and enjoy a refreshing blast of fruity fun!
Instructions: Match similar fruits to clear the board, earn points, and complete the goals of each level.
